title: Tamsin and the Confession
author: Dominic Joubert
blurb: Emrys Thornbury, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
